Find photos by filters, by meaning or by look-alike
Read one photo, the people, the albums and the library statistics
See a photo or a numbered contact sheet of up to 16 photos
Find faces that look like a recognised person
Move the user's tab to another page or open a photo
Change what the gallery shows and read it back
Select photos in the tab and read the selection back
Rate, favourite or reject a few photos

Set a photo's caption or write XMP sidecars next to the files
Review junk-sweep candidates and reject or keep them

tools.description: Move the user's open Facet tab to another page (gallery, persons, albums, stats, ...).

route.description: Where to go. Edition-only pages (/culling, /junk, /compare, /merge-suggestions) are refused by the tab for other users.

tools.name: ui_navigate

tools.description: Change the gallery filters and sort in the user's open tab. `patch` merges into the current filters (null removes one); `replace: true` starts from none.

min_similarity.description: Minimum similarity for `similar_to`, 0 to 1 (null: the tab default).

semantic_query.description: Show the gallery as a semantic (text-to-image) search for this text.

semantic_threshold.description: Semantic match threshold, 0 to 0.5 (null: the server default).

similar_to.description: Show the photos similar to the photo at this path. Cannot be combined with `semantic_query`.

replace.description: true: reset every other filter first.

tools.name: ui_set_gallery_filters

tools.description: What the user's tab shows now: route, active filters, total matches, the first visible photo paths and the selection count.

limit.description: Most visible photo paths to return.

tools.name: ui_get_gallery_view

tools.description: Open one photo in the user's tab (the detail view).

path.description: Path of the photo to open.

tools.name: ui_open_photo

tools.description: Show exactly these photos, in this order, as the gallery's list (max 200). Photos the user cannot see are skipped and returned as `missing`. Any filter change by the user or the assistant replaces the list.

paths.description: Photo paths to show, in this order, as the gallery's own list. The user's filters and sort are left untouched; any filter change replaces the list.

tools.name: ui_show_photos

tools.description: Change the selection in the user's tab: explicit `paths`, or the whole filtered view (`select_view`). Selecting does not modify any photo.

paths.description: Photo paths to select. Exactly one of `paths` and `select_view`.

select_view.description: true: select the WHOLE filtered view (not just the loaded rows), scope 'view'. Only with mode replace or add.

tools.name: ui_select_photos

tools.description: Clear the selection in the user's tab.
tools.name: ui_clear_selection

tools.description: The user's current selection: `scope` 'paths' (explicit `paths`) or 'view' (the whole filtered view: `filters`, minus `excluded_paths`), and `count`.
tools.name: ui_get_selection

tools.description: Where the user's tab is, from any page: route, the open photo, the selection (scope and count), a gallery summary (total, loaded, has_more, pinned list) when the gallery is open, the mounted page actions and the jobs that apply now (`actions`, with their tools), and `culling`, the assistant's plan on the /culling page (null outside plan mode): `{plan_digest, groups_total, confirmed, pending, changed, untouched, plan_truncated}`. `confirmed` and `pending` list plan group numbers (confirmed: the user's confirm has landed; pending: flipped away from the plan and not yet confirmed); `untouched` counts the rest. `changed` lists every group whose keepers differ from the plan as `{type, group_id, number, keep_paths, reject_paths}`: pass those paths as `keep_paths` / `remove_paths` on the next `auto_cull` dry run and on its apply. `plan_truncated` is true when the plan itself was capped (500 groups / 5000 photos) so it lists only part of the library's groups. When the block is too large for one answer its lists are cut: `culling.truncated` is true (it means only that) and `groups_total` / the list lengths stay the true counts. Never re-decide a confirmed group. `user_activity` ({items, until, truncated}) lists what the user did in the tab after `activity_since` (rating, reject, favorite, cull_confirm, cull_skip, tags, album, navigation; at most 50 items of 20 paths); pass the answer's `until` as the next `activity_since`. `culling_defaults` ({profile, strictness}) is the /culling page's current setting: the profile the user stored (null if none) and the slider's live, stored strictness; `auto_cull` plans with both (the strictness wins, the profile supplies its other settings) when given neither knob. Showing a plan moves the slider to the plan's strictness; moving the slider while a plan is shown re-plans it, so `culling.plan_digest` changes (read `ui_get_context` again before the next dry run).

activity_since.description: Only the user's own actions after this sequence number are returned in `user_activity`; pass the previous answer's `until`. Omitted: everything the tab still holds. Nothing advances on the tab, so a repeated call returns the same items.

tools.name: ui_get_context

tools.description: Load the next page of the gallery in the user's tab (infinite scroll).
tools.name: ui_next_page

tools.description: Open the darkroom (/culling) and focus one group, identified by (type, group_id). Edition accounts only.

type.description: Group kind; a group's identity is (type, group_id).

tools.name: ui_show_culling_group

tools.description: Open the darkroom (/culling) on an `auto_cull` plan: the same groups, keep/reject borders, loupe and compare as manual culling, with the plan's keepers pre-selected for the user to flip and confirm. `auto_cull` calls this for you on a dry run; call it yourself only to re-show a plan. The same `plan_digest` as the plan already shown only moves the focus. A different one replaces the plan and is refused with `unsaved_decisions` while the user holds decisions they have not confirmed; `plan_changed` means the library moved since the preview (preview again); `plan_load_failed` means the tab could not load the plan for any other reason. Edition accounts only.

focus.description: 1-based plan group number to land on (default: leave the focus).

plan_digest.description: The `plan_digest` of the `auto_cull` dry run being shown; the tab verifies it.

request.description:
The inputs of one auto-cull plan, shared by every surface that reproduces it.

``POST /api/culling/auto`` (as the base of its body), ``POST /api/culling/plan`` and the assistant's
``auto_cull`` tool build the same plan from these fields, so the digest one of them reports is the digest
the others recompute. ``highlights_album`` only feeds the digest; a plan confirmed in the tab never adds
highlights.

tools.name: ui_show_culling_plan

tools.description: Open the /compare page in the user's tab, optionally on one category and strategy. It only opens the page: the user picks the winners, nothing is submitted for them.

category.description: Category to compare within (a name from `facet://categories`).

strategy.description: Pair-selection strategy. Default: the tab's current one.

tools.name: ui_show_comparison
